title: NVIDIA releases NVFP4 quantized weights for Moonshot AI Kimi K3.1 Pro
summary: NVIDIA published an NVFP4 quantized release of Moonshot AI's Kimi K3.1 Pro multimodal mixture-of-experts model on Hugging Face, packaged with NVIDIA Model Optimizer for deployment in vLLM and TensorRT-LLM.
research_notes:
Retrieve the quantized model weights repository from Hugging Face using huggingface-cli.

Initialize a serving cluster using an inference engine supporting NVFP4 quantization such as vLLM or TensorRT-LLM.

Dispatch multimodal requests combining text prompts and high-resolution images within the one-million token context window.

Deploy across multi-GPU nodes with high NVLink bandwidth to handle active expert routing and large distributed KV cache requirements.

Enable native 4-bit floating point tensor core acceleration in supported inference engines like vLLM or TensorRT-LLM to maximize throughput on modern NVIDIA architectures.
